text:
anya: Adaptive batching launch — quick cross-team maturity checkpoint. Need final owners for: SLA targets, docs MVD, support runbook, monitoring alerts, pricing plan. Goal: sign-off by EOD Friday. Anyone?
jake: I can pick up SLA targets + canary plan. Proposed SLOs: P50 <50ms, P95 <120ms, P99 <250ms for request sizes <=512 tokens on rtx-6000 class; ramp to P90 99.5% over 30d. Is that acceptable?
maria: I'll own docs MVD. Outline: quickstart, config guide for batching knobs, troubleshooting, migration notes. Need sample cURL + SDK snippets.
samir: Support will own runbook + tiering. Need clear error mappings and 2 escalation paths. Can we freeze error codes by Wed?
olivia: Finance: need pricing tiers. Proposal: token-tier + throughput-seat for dedicated. Also fallback discount for pilot customers. Need final numbers to feed quotes.
jake: canary plan: 2-week canary in prod, 1% traffic -> 10% -> 50% with automated rollback on P95 200% spike or error-rate >0.5%. Will wire via rollout policy.
anya: Sounds good. Maria add SDK+curl to MVD. Samir we'll need support-sidebook snippets like `how to repro high p99`.
maria: Added a TODO in docs tracker and started a draft: https://ourdocs.internal/adaptive-batching/mvd (placeholder).
deploy-bot: Canary job started: `canary/adaptive-batching/2026-07-05` — baseline tests running.
samir: Can we get a 'what to tell customers' blurb for pilot? Short FAQ + expected behavior when batching increases latency.
anya: I'll draft customer-facing blurb. Draft to be sent to #support for sign-off.
olivia: Question: Is SLA for hosted APIs same as dedicated? We should differentiate — hosted best-effort, dedicated contractual SLA.
jake: Agree. We'll publish recommended configs for dedicated to meet contractual SLA. Hosted will have soft SLOs with sticky fallbacks.
maria: Docs note: call out config `batch_max_size`, `batch_timeout_ms`. Example snippet:
```
client.config({batch_max_size: 64, batch_timeout_ms: 10})
```
samir: Support runbook needs exact alert thresholds. Tentative: p95 latency > 300ms for 10m, error rate > 0.3% for 5m. Owners: Samir, Jake on-call.
anya: Assign owners: SLA/Jake, Docs/Maria, Support/Samir, Monitoring/Jake, Pricing/Olivia. If anyone wants to swap speak now.
olivia: I'll take pricing but want a review with legal for pilot discounts.
jake: I'll add monitoring dashboards: token-cost, batching efficiency, p99 by token-range, KV cache hit-rate.
anya: Final asks before EOD: each owner posts a 2-line acceptance criteria and link to docs/artifacts here. I'll collect for final signoff.
samir: :thumbsup: I'll post runbook link in the morning.
